lines: Riders online now has a lobby: it seats you in a live race and counts down with everyone in it.
From level three, Race Setup counts the riders queuing for the map, and Find a race opens the lobby.
The service seats you in the fullest open race on the map, or opens one that starts thirty seconds later.
Riders come and go as it happens; when one leaves, their seat opens again and the lobby says who.
At ten seconds, bots take every open seat so the race starts full, and the first stretch's resistance goes to the bike.
On a laptop the clock sits beside the grid; on a phone the grid runs underneath.
What the tests prove: seated by the hub, the grid in step for everyone, bots at ten, and your seat freed when you go.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
